summary: Hostel 360 full-stack test. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests passed covering auth (login/register/me, wrong password 401, admin-role restriction 422), public search (list, city/gender/max_budget filters, detail with reviews+available_beds+room_options, enquiry create), admin (dashboard KPIs, pending hostels list, verify approve/suspend/reactivate, owners list, plans CRUD+toggle, 403 for owner/tenant), owner (dashboard, hostel CRUD, room add/list/delete, tenant add+transfer+checkout+delete, rent collection with receipt_no & payment_status update, expenses CRUD, reports monthly/by_category, notices, complaints, enquiries, 403 on tenant route), tenant (home with allocation, payments, notices, complaint flow visible to owner, request), and payments (subscription+rent checkout return 400 'not configured' as expected; sub checkout enforces owner role 403). Frontend: Public search screen loads 5 seeded hostel cards with images and chip filters (gender=boys narrows to 1). Hostel detail opens with photos, room types (₹9500 single / ₹7000 double / ₹6500 double / ₹5500 triple), amenities, and enquiry sheet submits successfully with 'Request sent!' toast. Login for admin@hostel360.com, owner@hostel360.com, tenant@hostel360.com all route to their correct portals (stat-hostels / stat-collection / room-details visible). Owner rooms tab shows 4 rooms with bed statuses and delete buttons on empty rooms. Money tab shows Total collected ₹7100 with receipt-numbered payment history and Rent/Expenses toggle. Tenants tab lists Amit Verma with Manage action and Add Tenant modal (Full name, Mobile, Email, Room selector chips, Rent, Deposit, Advance, 'Create tenant login' checkbox default Tenant@12345). Tenant dashboard shows Monthly Rent card (PAID after backend rent test), Room Details (T0404EA, Room 102, Bed 102-1, Deposit ₹14000, Advance ₹7000), and Call Owner button. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Update dict is written twice (once inside reset_password branch, once at end) — harmless but redundant. Actual behavior correct.

integration_issues.flow: Owner logout → login again in same session
integration_issues.issue: After tapping [data-testid=owner-logout] a subsequent wait for [data-testid=login-email] timed out at 8s in the automation session. Fresh page loads render the login screen instantly. Likely a router-replace vs push nuance in Expo Router — verify AuthContext state clears on logout.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings emitted: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), and Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web. Not blocking, but pollute console. Consider migrating shadow* → boxShadow via a small StyleSheet helper.
Toast/alert in enquiry uses default Alert.alert on web — visually shows as banner (works).

action_items: (Optional) Investigate that logging out from owner portal returns cleanly to /(auth)/login without state-race — verify router.replace('/(auth)/login') is used in AuthContext.logout, and token/user are cleared before navigating.
(Optional) Migrate any shadow* style props to boxShadow to remove Expo web deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required — payments returning 400 with friendly 'not configured' message is verified and expected per spec until STRIPE_API_KEY is set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 1327 lines is large but cohesive — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/owner.py, routers/admin.py, routers/tenant.py, routers/payments.py for future maintainability.
reset_password branch in POST /api/admin/owners/{id}/action performs update+return inside branch but the final line also runs `await db.users.update_one` — refactor to a single write path.
get_current_user token order is JWT then session-token; both paths correctly clean _id and honor blocked flag.
All Mongo reads use projection {"_id":0}. No ObjectId leaks were observed in responses. Good.
Pydantic Literal enforcement on RegisterBody.role prevents privilege escalation to admin (returns 422 as verified in tests).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows verified; single flaky post-logout re-login navigation in one session)
